title: Industrial Designer I
note: Home comfort appliances (fans, heaters); 0–2 years of experience.

facts.summary: Entry-level industrial designer for fans, heaters and air purifiers.
facts.duties: Sketches, models in CAD and renders concepts, supports CMF, and builds and finishes prototypes.
facts.requirements: Industrial or product design bachelor's, SolidWorks, KeyShot, Adobe CC, a portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply via Greenhouse with a portfolio.
